name: DeepFund
description: DeepFund is a live fund investment benchmark tool designed to evaluate large language models in real-time market conditions, avoiding information leakage from historical back-testing. It connects to real-time stock market data post model training cutoff to fairly assess LLMs on tasks like ticker analysis, investment decision-making, portfolio management, and risk control.
reputation: A recent research benchmark/tool with limited public adoption so far, mainly used to evaluate LLMs under live market conditions.
notes: Addresses leakage issues in financial benchmarks by using live data; evaluates real-time trading performance of LLMs.
